title: Salomon's first SG outlet opens at IMM — up to 50% off
description: Salomon opened its first-ever Singapore outlet at IMM on 5 September 2026, marking the occasion with opening deals of up to 50% off selected products plus exclusive gifts with purchase. The store stocks the French outdoor brand's trail-running shoes, hiking footwear and everyday athleisure — worth a look if comfortable travel or walking shoes are on your list.
why: First Salomon outlet in Singapore with opening-week discounts of up to 50% — the best prices you'll see on the brand for a while.
address: #02-43, IMM Building, 2 Jurong East Street 21, Singapore 609601
parking: IMM multi-storey carpark; Jurong East MRT is next door.

title: Novela opens at Changi City Point — $160 beauty bag promo
description: Beauty retailer Novela opened a new outlet at Changi City Point (B1-24/25) on 3 September 2026. Until 16 September, VIP Gold members who spend $188 in a single transaction receive an exclusive Beauty Bag worth up to $160 — including two full-sized Kenzo and Monotheme fragrances plus gifts from Embryolisse, ISDIN, Clarins, ELIXIR and ANESSA, and a $10 off $100 voucher.
why: Opening promo runs to 16 Sep only — a $160 beauty bag for VIP Gold members spending $188, while stocks last.
address: B1-24/25, Changi City Point, 5 Changi Business Park Central 1, Singapore 486038
parking: Changi City Point carpark; Expo MRT is beside the mall.

title: CHAGEE's first family-friendly store lands at Suntec City
description: CHAGEE opened its first family-friendly concept store at Suntec City in early September 2026. The refreshed format centres on a tiered play seating area for children with multi-level booths, soft-touch materials, a digital screen with motion-based games, and complimentary milk for young visitors — while parents get their tea fix nearby.
why: Brand-new store concept opened days ago — the first CHAGEE designed around kids, with play seating and free milk for children.
parking: Suntec City carpark; Promenade / Esplanade / City Hall MRT nearby.

title: HOMEGROWN Festival 2026 — free gigs with Regina Song & brb.
description: HOMEGROWN Festival returns for its third edition at PLQ Plaza, Paya Lebar, from 11 to 13 September 2026. Organised by the Music & Drama Company, it's headlined by bedroom-pop star Regina Song and pop-groove favourites brb., with Forests, Ice Cream Sundays, 10pm Noise Complaint and MDC talents RINES, Dominic Chin and Gail Belmonte also on the bill. Entry is free, with pop-up retail booths on site.
why: Catch international-level Singapore talent live for free — Regina Song and brb. headline a three-day festival this weekend.
address: PLQ Plaza, 10 Paya Lebar Road, Singapore 409057
parking: PLQ Mall carpark; Paya Lebar MRT is right there.

title: Liberation of Singapore — 81 years of freedom, free events
description: Marking 81 years since the end of WWII, Liberation of Singapore runs 11-13 September across two venues: Changi Chapel and Museum, and Reflections at Bukit Chandu. The programme includes walking tours, talks, kids' craft sessions and 'Heritage in Harmony', a concert of WWII camp songs performed live for the first time since the war ended. All events are free but registration is required.
why: A rare long-weekend of free heritage programming — including WWII camp songs performed live for the first time since 1945.
address: Changi Chapel and Museum, 1000 Upper Changi Road North, Singapore 507707
parking: On-site parking at the museum; shuttle/taxi recommended.

title: Singapore River Festival 2026 — The Quay Collective
description: The Singapore River Festival marks its 10th edition from 11 to 20 September 2026 with 'The Quay Collective'. All three quays get experience zones: an Acai Social dance session inside Clarke Quay's oldest heritage building, an outdoor Monopoly: Hidden Singapore clue adventure, the Whispers of the Twin Quays boat-and-walk tour, and the River Echo Chambers projection wall at Boat Quay. Admission is free, with some ticketed experiences.
why: The 10th edition of the river festival runs through the whole week — riverside light art, dance floors and bumboat tours, mostly free.
address: Various venues along the Singapore River — Clarke Quay, Robertson Quay, Boat Quay, Singapore
parking: Clarke Quay / Riverside Point carparks; Clarke Quay MRT nearby.

title: Twilight: Flea & Feast — giant indoor pasar malam at Suntec
description: Twilight: Flea & Feast takes over Halls 401-403 of Suntec City Convention Centre from 11 to 13 September 2026, turning two huge convention halls into one of the biggest indoor markets in the city. Expect food, beauty, fashion and lifestyle stalls plus a schedule of performances — all under air-con, so the weekend heat is a non-issue. Admission is free.
why: One of Singapore's biggest indoor markets runs this weekend only — free entry, AC-cooled, and packed with food and shopping stalls.
address: Hall 401-403, Suntec City Convention Centre, 1 Raffles Boulevard, Singapore 039593
parking: Suntec City carpark; Promenade / Esplanade MRT nearby.

title: Kids' mooncake-making workshop at Holland International School
description: A hands-on Mid-Autumn workshop where kids make mooncake dough from scratch, shape their own mooncakes and take them home to share with family. All ingredients are halal and vegetarian; children under 14 attend with a parent. Well timed for the Mid-Autumn Festival on 25 September.
why: A seasonal, hands-on cultural tradition — kids leave with mooncakes they made themselves.
parking: Free parking on site, per the event listing.

title: Bilingual Eco-Festival 2026 — free family festival at One Punggol
description: A free family festival celebrating bilingualism and sustainability through storytelling, performances, hands-on activities and eco-learning, held at the One Punggol community hub.
why: Free, bilingual and green — a full family morning in Punggol with real substance.

title: Dawn intertidal marine tour at Changi Beach with Biogirl MJ
description: A guided dawn walk across Changi's intertidal zone with marine educator Biogirl MJ, discovering the hidden marine life on Singapore's own shores — crabs, seastars and more at low tide. Listed at a special price for this date.
why: Singapore's wild side before sunrise — a marine biologist shows you what the tide leaves behind.

title: Daddy & daughter hair workshop at Love Hair, Keong Saik
description: A hands-on workshop at Keong Saik salon Love Hair where dads learn real hair skills — braids, buns and beyond — to bond with their daughters. Small, practical and genuinely sweet.
why: The most wholesome two hours of the weekend: dads leave able to do more than a ponytail.

title: World Cleanup Day family cleanup at East Coast Park
description: Join a family-and-all-generations community cleanup at East Coast Park's Raintree Cove (near carpark C3 & C4) for World Cleanup Day. All welcome — a meaningful late-afternoon outdoors with the kids.
why: Do some good together — a free, feel-good family afternoon on the beach.
address: East Coast Park, Raintree Cove (near carpark C3 & C4), Singapore

title: Private kayaking at Pasir Ris Beach — kids & pets welcome
description: A private, guided kayaking experience launching from Pasir Ris Beach with KOKOMO Beach Club. Kids and even pets are welcome, so the whole family — dog included — can paddle together.
why: Kayaking with the kids — and the dog. Private, guided and genuinely different.
address: 131 Pasir Ris Road (Carpark E), Pasir Ris Beach, Singapore 519148

title: Kids' lamian-pulling challenge at Western Mahua, HarbourFront
description: A family session at hand-pulled noodle restaurant Western Mahua where parents and kids learn to pull lamian by hand, enjoy a meal together and take home a surprise. Also runs 11 Oct.
why: Kids learn to pull noodles like pros, then eat them — dinner and a show in one.

title: Charity yoga at Coastal Playgrove, East Coast Park
description: Yoga for a Change runs weekly charity yoga classes at East Coast Park's Coastal Playgrove every Sunday morning — an hour of open-air flow where your ticket supports a good cause.
why: Sunday-morning yoga by the sea, and the fee does good.
address: Coastal Playgrove, East Coast Park, Singapore 449874

title: One-day Pichwai painting workshop in Serangoon
description: A 2.5-hour workshop in the traditional Rajasthani art of Pichwai — intricate devotional painting — and you leave carrying a finished piece you painted yourself. Exact studio details on booking.
why: A rare chance to try a centuries-old Indian art form in a single afternoon.

title: Charity HIIT bootcamp at The Lawn, Marina Bay
description: A high-intensity bootcamp on The Lawn at Marina Bay run by Because – Sports to Support, where your sweat raises money for charity. Monday-night training with a conscience.
why: Twelve dollars, one hard workout, money to charity — the easiest good deed of the week.
address: 8A Marina Boulevard, The Lawn @ Marina Bay, Singapore 018984
